summary: The change does what the task and every agreed decision ask. In index.html, #btn-kanban and #btn-gantt are gone from .header-actions (so #btn-cal-sync is now followed directly by the map-button comment) and appear as direct children of #toolbar-groups, right after the bordered .toolbar-filters box and outside it, preceded by a .toolbar-sep. They use the flat tb-btn class, and their ids, labels, onclick handlers, data-i/data-i-title keys and titles are byte-identical to the originals. No CSS or JS selector depended on the header placement (a repo-wide grep finds the ids only in index.html and tests/gantt.js, which targets them by id). The docs/FEATURES.md Kanban sentence was updated to the new location, and docs/MAP.md has no anchor that the ±1 line shift invalidates. I confirmed by running them: `node tests/verify.js` passes (parse, nine-way nav sync, diacritics), the new suite tests/03-move-kanban-and-gantt-buttons-from/buttons.js passes all 12 check groups, and tests/gantt.js still passes. The suite's checks are real ones: header absence and uniqueness, parentage and sibling order, preserved attributes and class, RO/EN labels and tooltips through the real language toggle, desktop geometry relative to .toolbar-filters, click and keyboard activation, the accepted ☰ collapse hiding the buttons and restoring them, and #btn-cal-sync staying in the header. Non-blocking note: like the earlier per-task suites (01, 02, 03-idee), this one is not in tests/package.json's `npm test` loop. That matches existing repo practice, so it is not a defect of this task.
